state.goal: Use 정부24 to get "주민등록표 초본" (내 주소가 바뀌어 온 기록(이사 다닌 기록)이 나오는 서류) through the 정부24 service "주민등록표 등본(초본) 발급", and if it issues a document, print it on this computer. On the application form, choose 초본, not 등본.
state.userSituation: An older Korean citizen who is not used to computers. They log in and prove identity with mobile simple authentication (간편인증, e.g. KakaoTalk or Naver).

instructions.question: Which one of the on-screen controls should the user use next to make progress toward `goal`?
rules: Consider `userSituation`, the current `page`, and `alreadyPressed` (controls the user used earlier, oldest first).
If a pop-up window is open on top of the page (its text is `page.popupText`), pick the control in it that continues toward the goal.
Prefer controls in the main content of this page over site-wide header, footer or menu links, unless the goal can only be reached through the menu.
If the page asks the user to choose an authentication or login method (such as 공동인증서, 금융인증서 or 간편인증), pick the method described in `userSituation`.

On a form, fields already filled in and options already selected are done. Pick an empty field only if this user must fill it; skip optional settings (such as a security-keyboard option) and fields meant for other kinds of users (such as foreigner ID fields for a Korean citizen). Once the needed fields are done, pick the control that submits or continues.
Do not pick controls that log out, cancel, go back, close the page, or start a different service.
On a terms or consent page, agree only to required (필수) items; never pick optional (선택) consents or "agree to all".

criteria.해당 없음: None of the listed controls moves the user closer to the goal right now.

pageStage.instructions: Which step of reaching `goal` does the current `page` show?

criteria.민원 찾기: A home, search or list page where the user still has to find the service in `goal`.
criteria.민원 안내: The information page of the service in `goal`, which has the button that starts an application.
criteria.로그인: A page or window for choosing a login or authentication method (such as 공동인증서, 금융인증서, 간편인증) or otherwise proving identity, even if it also has name or ID-number fields.
criteria.약관 동의: A page asking the user to agree to terms or to the use of personal information.
criteria.신청서 작성: An application form for choosing what the document includes and how it is received. Not a page whose main step is proving identity with an authentication method.
criteria.신청 완료·인쇄: A page after applying, where the user opens, views or prints the issued document.
criteria.프로그램 설치: A page asking the user to install a security or printing program.
criteria.관련 없는 화면: A page unrelated to the service in `goal`.
